description: The bar chart, titled "Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods on Static Experiments," illustrates the average entropy values for three different AI models—GPT-4, Claude, and Llama—under three distinct methods: Baseline, Source Info, and Direct Command. The vertical axis, labeled "Entropy Average Values," ranges from 3.0 to 6.0, with the horizontal axis listing the models. For each model, three bars represent the three methods, with the Baseline method shown in pink, Source Info in yellow, and Direct Command in light blue. The chart shows that for GPT-4, the Source Info method yields the highest average entropy (approximately 5.3), followed by Direct Command (approximately 5.1), and then Baseline (approximately 4.9). For Claude, the Source Info method again has the highest entropy (approximately 5.2), followed by Direct Command (approximately 5.0), and then Baseline (approximately 4.7). For Llama, the Source Info method has the highest entropy (approximately 5.0), followed by Direct Command (approximately 4.8), and then Baseline (approximately 4.6). In all three models, the Source Info method consistently results in the highest average entropy, while the Baseline method results in the lowest.
